name: smwgraphics-3d-pinball-express-terrormeister
title: 3D Pinball Express - Terrormeister
description:
A Background that appears in one of the Themes from 3D Pinball Express. It was edited and it's palette very optimized to fit in SMW. Althrough it's small, it uses almost all of the 3 slots of BG. Works well on Cemetery/Graveyards or Haunted places.
Happy Halloween!
